evidence.title: Close independent L2 R2 risks on CAP-INV-004 pivot HTTP drafts
evidence.goal: Preserve authorized Event Inspector read behavior while making pivot draft a distinct host-authorized action, rejecting ambiguous multi-origin source provenance and applying the same Inspector payload/field bounds.
outputs: Optional explicit PivotAuthorizer host injection, default NewHandler pivots fail closed but reads remain supported
Ambiguous same field/value origin is rejected before copy
Shared browser projection bounds enforced on pivot
acceptance_tests: Legacy NewHandler without pivot authority denies pivot but preserves read.
Action-specific provider deny/error blocks draft even when Search and Telemetry reads succeed; allow then succeeds.
Multiple matching origins (source+normalized, two enrichment producers) rejected with no arbitrary origin.
Value >4096 or owner projection maps violating Inspector bounds reject pivot without a partial result.
Original host/core regression plus engineering security gates and cross-platform CI success on exact HEAD.

rules: Old NewHandler still supports POST /investigate/event-inspection but no longer *grants a pivot* merely because the Event and its source projection may be read. The pivot URL fails closed if no independently supplied PivotAuthorizer. Hosts explicitly opt in with NewHandlerWithPivotAuthorizer(sessions, searchOwner, telemetryOwner, pivotActionAuthorizer); an authentic host must check principal, tenant/environment, Search Job/run and field-specific *copy/pivot* action. It may reuse a host IAM source, but cannot infer pivot permission from read. A synthetic Search owner mock implements the separate action permission for tests; this is not deployed IAM or a real security policy.

The original trusted SessionResolver, SearchOwner and TelemetryOwner chain still reauthorizes the selected Event before the action check. Original Project + PreparePivot code is reused. The action authorizer is called only after existing Inspector-wide map/enrichment/raw/rendered payload validation and uniqueness of selected field+value provenance.

A field/value appearing in two visible source maps or in two enrichment producers is rejected rather than reporting the arbitrary first map. A single exact origin is allowed; missing map keys, denied raw-derived map and wrong value remain denied.

Reuse original toBrowserProjection to apply all existing Inspector field/key/value, enrichments, missing fields, raw/rendered payload bounds before attempting draft preparation; selected value is capped to 4096 bytes. The host does not request a second source or use client flags to choose authority.
